decision_conditions:
CONDITION: Prior to the commencement of the use hereby permitted details of proposed measures and controls to mitigate air quality impacts of the emergency generators shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Such details shall include:

- consideration of the use of lower polluting fuels such as Hydrotreated Vegetable Oil (HVO)
- engines to be optimised to reduce emissions (“emissions optimised”)
- consideration of particulate traps
- consideration of selective catalytic reduction (SCR)
- any other measures 

All mitigation measures and controls shall be installed before commencement of the use thereby permitted and permanently retained thereafter.

REASON: In the interest of air quality and protection of neighbouring residential amenity.
description: Erection of a new 5-storey building to accommodate an energy centre (including electrical infrastructure, plant and new emergency generators), bulk storage facilities and office accommodation, with associated access, servicing and external works. RE-CONSULTATION: THE APPLICATION REPRESENTS A DEPARTURE FROM THE DEVELOPMENT PLAN (the height of the chimney exceeds 30m and is outside of sites designated for tall buildings).
